WHAT THE CONTRACT ADDS

Crowd direction stays unreadable until entry is over.

  1. SEALED

    The chain stores a hash, amount and account—not the chosen side.

  2. VERIFIED

    Reveal recomputes market + bettor + side + salt and rejects any mismatch.

  3. RECOVERABLE

    Unrevealed stakes remain reclaimable after the window. Invalid markets refund revealed stakes.

AUTOMATIC RESOLUTION PATH

One booked wake-up.
Three bounded attempts.

RITUAL SCHEDULERscheduled block→ HTTP 0x0801oracle response→ JQ 0x0803uint extraction→ POOLpayout / refund

If HTTP or jq fails, CipherBook retries. Failure is never interpreted as NO; after the final attempt, the market becomes refundable.
